description.zh: 从写第一行代码，到把站点交给用户。
description.en: From the first line of code to a site people can use.

decision.zh: 已有常用扩展，先确认兼容性；更看重协作，就比较共享编辑和项目支持。
decision.en: Check support for the extensions you rely on, or compare shared editing and project support if collaboration comes first.

decision.zh: 需要终端扩展和脚本时看 mitmproxy；喜欢图形界面时，先核对 Proxyman 断点和本地模拟的套餐限制。
decision.en: Consider mitmproxy for terminal and scripting workflows. If you prefer a graphical UI, check Proxyman's plan limits for breakpoints and local mocking.

decision.zh: 先分清静态站还是要跑函数，再看免费档的计算额度与商用条款。
decision.en: Decide whether the site needs functions or is purely static, then check compute allowances and commercial-use terms.

description.zh: 录一段讲解，剪掉废话，再做一张封面。
description.en: Record a walkthrough, trim it down and make a cover.

decision.zh: 需要跨平台、直播或多场景时看 OBS；在 Mac 上要快速做带缩放和光标效果的演示时看 Screen Studio。
decision.en: Consider OBS for cross-platform recording, streaming or multiple scenes. Consider Screen Studio for Mac demos with zoom and cursor effects.

decision.zh: 比较开源剪辑流程和一站式调色需求，先拿一段自己的素材确认编码兼容。
decision.en: Compare open-source editing with an all-in-one grading workflow, and check codec compatibility with one of your own clips.

decision.zh: 需要桌面修图和合成时看 GIMP；要在浏览器里打开 PSD 时，先用一份实际模板验证图层效果。
decision.en: Consider GIMP for desktop editing and compositing. If working with PSDs in the browser, test the layers in a template you actually use.

description.zh: 先想清楚数据放哪，再选笔记、密码和阅读工具。
description.en: Decide where your data should live before choosing notes, passwords and reading tools.

decision.zh: 对比自己保管 KDBX 文件和跨设备同步两种方式，也想好设备丢失时怎么恢复。
decision.en: Compare keeping your own KDBX file with cross-device sync, and plan how to recover access if a device is lost.

decision.zh: 先试导出和重新导入，再比较本地 Markdown、同步方式和附件能否一起迁移。
decision.en: Try an export and reimport first. Compare local Markdown, sync options and whether attachments move with your notes.

decision.zh: 只在苹果设备读，可从本机客户端开始；想自己管跨设备订阅和状态，再考虑自托管聚合器。
decision.en: Start with a local client if you read on Apple devices. Consider a self-hosted aggregator if you want to manage subscriptions and reading state across devices.
